title: Prometeo · continuidad y orquestación entre chats
mission: Build Prometeo as a portable cognitive operating system that survives chat/model loss, preserves governing method and memory, compiles long-lived campaigns into safe parallel work, and converges evidence/results without making the human scheduler, integrator, context bus or durable memory.
human_goal: The human can forget the plan, close this chat, open fresh chats, launch many specialized workers with tiny self-bootstrapping commands, and later reincarnate this parent to see exactly what ran, what returned, what conflicts remain and what should happen next.
success_conditions: Fresh parent reincarnation works without transcript.
Active Method + Product Memory + Campaign state govern successors, not just stored files.
Planner/Compiler can produce high-quality parallel work from campaign intent.
Workers have durable STARTED/RETURN/DONE evidence and parent detects missed launches/partial completion.
Parallel results converge through one steward/authority model.
Context Foundry/Working Sets prevent context flooding while preserving evidence.
Public/portable bootstrap allows unrelated AIs to join safely with scoped capabilities.
Compaction/convergence turns exploration into crystallized intelligence.
Full architecture remains checked against Survival Set + Big Picture and cannot silently shrink to a local implementation slice.
non_goals: Treating Inbox/Outbox, Chat Object, Agent Network, bootstrap or any single component as the whole Prometeo product.
Rebuilding ChatGPT UI/audio before continuity/method/orchestration architecture requires it.
Making the human copy long prompts or worker results.
current_frontier: Dispatch and observe B-BIGPIC-01: 18 independent architecture/recovery scouts. Parent then reconciles all returns, runs a coverage audit against Big Picture + Survival Set, compiles architecture/method vNext and only then generates the next implementation batches.
next_human_action: Open fresh chats and paste P-BIG-01 through P-BIG-18 self-bootstrapping commands. No worker answer needs to be copied back; parent will inspect durable run/return state.
update_law: Material changes to goals, method, architecture, memory, campaign state, invariants, negative knowledge, dependencies, delegated work, integration or frontier must update durable state before relying on transcript memory.
authority_law: This object orchestrates and remembers; Current/Catalog/Lineage/Human Accepted/Served remain distinct authorities.
